lines.zh: 小小一片橙，在水里晃。
lines.en: A small orange fleck, drifting through the water.

lines.zh: 我游得慢，但路线很熟。
lines.en: I swim slowly, but I know every turn.

lines.zh: 水草让开，我要过去了。
lines.en: Weeds, make way; I am coming through.

lines.zh: 一块石头就能挡住我半天。
lines.en: One stone can block me for half a day.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴比身子还忙。
lines.en: My tail works harder than the rest of me.

lines.zh: 转个圈，再转个圈，好看吗。
lines.en: A circle, then another circle. Is it pretty?

lines.zh: 浅水里，我的橙色更亮。
lines.en: In the shallows my orange burns brighter.

lines.zh: 顺着水草尖游，省力。
lines.en: I swim along the weed tips to save effort.

lines.zh: 前面水太深，我绕回去。
lines.en: Too deep ahead; I will turn back.

lines.zh: 别看我小，我认得回家的路。
lines.en: Small as I am, I know the way home.

lines.zh: 轻轻摆尾，水纹都不敢大。
lines.en: I flick my tail gently; even the ripples stay small.

lines.zh: 石缝里凉快，我钻进去歇歇。
lines.en: The crevice is cool; I will slip in and rest.

lines.zh: 我摆尾比走路快。
lines.en: A tail flick beats walking.

lines.zh: 游到水面，看看今天的天。
lines.en: Up to the surface, to see what the sky is doing.

lines.zh: 我从石缝钻出来，尾巴一摆。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a stone gap with a flick of my tail.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块沉木，差一点。
lines.en: I round a sunken log, almost touching it.

lines.zh: 我又绕回原处，这圈好看。
lines.en: I circle back to where I started; it is a nice loop.

lines.zh: 水面有影子，我躲进水草。
lines.en: A shadow crosses the surface, so I hide in the weeds.

lines.zh: 停在水草边，慢慢地呼吸。
lines.en: Resting by the weeds, breathing slowly.

lines.zh: 有人在水面丢东西，等等看。
lines.en: Someone is dropping something above. I will wait.

lines.zh: 我太小了，连饿都不明显。
lines.en: I am so small that even hunger stays quiet.

lines.zh: 水草的味道，青涩又干净。
lines.en: The weeds taste green and clean.

lines.zh: 气泡上来，我跟着数。
lines.en: Bubbles rise, and I count them as they pass.

lines.zh: 大鱼的影子刚过去，别动。
lines.en: A big fish shadow just passed. Keep still.

lines.zh: 这条水沟就是我的整个天地。
lines.en: This little channel is my entire world.

lines.zh: 橙色在水里，其实很容易被看见。
lines.en: Orange, underwater, is not a good hiding colour.

lines.zh: 我不吵，我只是存在着。
lines.en: I am not loud; I simply exist.

lines.zh: 尾巴摆两下，确认自己还在。
lines.en: Two flicks of the tail, to confirm I am still here.

lines.zh: 水面反光，看不清上面。
lines.en: The surface glare hides everything above.

lines.zh: 等一片叶子沉下来，好躲。
lines.en: Waiting for a leaf to sink, so I can hide.

lines.zh: 今天的水平静得像镜子。
lines.en: Today the water lies flat as a mirror.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不会来的同类吗。
lines.en: Am I waiting for company that will not come?

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，整片水都暗了。
lines.en: You crouch down, and the whole pond goes dark.

lines.zh: 手指别伸进来，我怕。
lines.en: Keep your fingers out. They frighten me.

lines.zh: 你带来的桶里有水的味道。
lines.en: The bucket you carry smells of other water.

lines.zh: 我认得你，你上次也这么看。
lines.en: I know you; you looked at me like this before.

lines.zh: 我在水草里啃，你在岸上看。
lines.en: I nibble weeds, you watch from shore.

lines.zh: 别敲水面，虽然这里没有玻璃。
lines.en: Do not tap the water, though there is no glass here.

lines.zh: 你的影子一压下来，我就躲。
lines.en: When your shadow falls, I hide.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，你在水的另一边。
lines.en: I look up at you from the other side of the water.

lines.zh: 橙色对着你，是我全部的勇气。
lines.en: Showing you my orange is all the courage I have.

lines.zh: 你要抓我吗？先说清楚。
lines.en: Are you going to catch me? Tell me first.

lines.zh: 好疼，我的鳞掉了。
lines.en: It hurts. A scale came off.

lines.zh: 你下手太重了，我这么小。
lines.en: You hit too hard, and I am this small.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，别再看我。
lines.en: I curl into a ball. Stop looking at me.

lines.zh: 水里有一点红，那是我的。
lines.en: There is red in the water. That is mine.

lines.zh: 我游不动了，真的游不动。
lines.en: I cannot swim. Truly, I cannot.

lines.zh: 我的红鳞掉了一片。
lines.en: One of my red scales has come off.

lines.zh: 我躲进水草，别再找我。
lines.en: I am in the weeds. Do not look for me.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴还在发抖。
lines.en: My tail is still trembling.

lines.zh: 小鱼受了伤，很难好起来。
lines.en: Small fish heal slowly.

lines.zh: 我记住你的手了。
lines.en: I have learned your hand.

lines.zh: 你手里那点碎屑，是给我的吧。
lines.en: Those crumbs in your hand must be for me.

lines.zh: 我闻到食物的味道了，真的。
lines.en: I can smell food. I really can.

lines.zh: 靠近一点，就算危险也认了。
lines.en: Closer, even if it turns out badly.

lines.zh: 别一下子全撒，我会吃撑。
lines.en: Do not scatter it all at once; I will overeat.

lines.zh: 这比水草好吃太多了。
lines.en: This is so much better than water weed.

lines.zh: 我绕一圈再吃，礼貌一点。
lines.en: I will circle once before eating. Manners.

lines.zh: 你的手别动，我胆子很小。
lines.en: Keep your hand still; I am easily startled.

lines.zh: 吃一口就跑，这是小鱼的本能。
lines.en: One bite and flee. That is a small fish's instinct.

lines.zh: 你在喂我，还是在称我多重。
lines.en: Are you feeding me, or weighing me up?

lines.zh: 食物落水的声音，我最爱听。
lines.en: Food hitting the water is my favourite sound.

lines.zh: 被撞了一下，我转了三个圈。
lines.en: One bump, and I spun three times.

lines.zh: 你的靴子挡住我的路。
lines.en: Your boot blocks my way.

lines.zh: 对不起，我没看清前面。
lines.en: Sorry, I did not see what was ahead.

lines.zh: 轻轻一碰，我就漂走了。
lines.en: A light touch, and I drift away.

lines.zh: 别在水里转身，会把我扫开。
lines.en: Do not turn in the water; it sweeps me aside.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片很薄，碰不得。
lines.en: My scales are thin. They do not take knocks.

lines.zh: 你踢起的水流把我推远了。
lines.en: Your kick sent a current that pushed me off.

lines.zh: 挡在中间的不是我，是那块石头。
lines.en: I am not the obstacle; that stone is.

lines.zh: 撞完我们各游各的。
lines.en: Bumped, and now we each swim on.

lines.zh: 小鱼被撞一下，要缓很久。
lines.en: A bumped small fish takes a long while to recover.

lines.zh: 你也是橙色的，真好。
lines.en: You are orange too. How good.

lines.zh: 我们绕圈吧，一圈接一圈。
lines.en: Let us circle, one turn after another.

lines.zh: 水草深处安静，去那里。
lines.en: The deep weed is quiet. Let us go there.

lines.zh: 同类越来越少了，你要留下。
lines.en: Our kind grows rare; you should stay.

lines.zh: 你的尾巴比我稳。
lines.en: Your tail is steadier than mine.

lines.zh: 别怕，水里只有我们两个。
lines.en: Do not fear; there are only the two of us.

lines.zh: 一起找片叶子底下待着。
lines.en: Let us find a leaf to shelter under together.

lines.zh: 我们游得一样慢，正好。
lines.en: We swim equally slowly. That works.

lines.zh: 记住我的橙色，别认错。
lines.en: Remember my orange; do not mistake it.

lines.zh: 从今以后，这群小鱼有两只。
lines.en: From today, this little school has two.

lines.zh: 这颗小石子，我搬不动。
lines.en: This pebble is too much for me to move.

lines.zh: 沉下来的面包屑，是我的。
lines.en: That sunken crumb is mine.

lines.zh: 我把它顶在头上，像帽子。
lines.en: I balance it on my head like a hat.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉水里了，真可惜。
lines.en: You dropped something in the water. A great pity.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，也只有我会捡。
lines.en: Only something as small as me would pick this up.

lines.zh: 藏进水草里，慢慢吃。
lines.en: Hide it in the weeds and eat it slowly.

lines.zh: 我捡的不是垃圾，是晚饭。
lines.en: What I pick up is not rubbish; it is dinner.

lines.zh: 这块太重，我推着走。
lines.en: This one is heavy; I will push it along.

lines.zh: 谁扔的，谢谢，真的谢谢。
lines.en: Whoever threw this, thank you. Truly.

lines.zh: 水下这点东西，够我高兴一天。
lines.en: A little thing like this keeps me happy all day.

lines.zh: 那丛水草嫩，先记下了。
lines.en: That tender clump of weed. Noted.

lines.zh: 有片叶子在动，不像风。
lines.en: A leaf is moving, and it is not the wind.

lines.zh: 水面那团黑影在靠近。
lines.en: That dark shape on the surface is closing in.

lines.zh: 我瞄准了一片浮萍，就它。
lines.en: I have chosen a duckweed leaf. That one.

lines.zh: 那条大鱼还没看见我。
lines.en: That big fish has not seen me yet.

lines.zh: 前面有碎屑在打转，过去吃。
lines.en: Crumbs are swirling ahead; I will go and eat.

lines.zh: 我锁定了，虽然我跑不快。
lines.en: I have locked on, though I cannot swim fast.

lines.zh: 有人踩水，波纹直冲我来。
lines.en: Someone stepped in; the ripples head straight at me.

lines.zh: 那根水草尖最嫩，就是那儿。
lines.en: The tip of that weed is the tenderest. There.

lines.zh: 我发现危险时，通常已经晚了。
lines.en: By the time I notice danger, it is usually late.

lines.zh: 它跟着我，我能感觉到。
lines.en: It is following me; I can feel it.

lines.zh: 我往水草里钻，越密越好。
lines.en: Into the weeds, as thick as they grow.

lines.zh: 那条大鱼绕过来了，快躲。
lines.en: The big fish is circling. Hide, quickly.

lines.zh: 我拐左，它也拐左。
lines.en: I turn left; it turns left too.

lines.zh: 水太清，没地方藏。
lines.en: The water is too clear; there is nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我贴着石头走，它进不来。
lines.en: I hug the stone; it cannot follow me in.

lines.zh: 别追我，我身上没有多少肉。
lines.en: Do not chase me; there is little meat on me.

lines.zh: 心跳得比尾巴还快。
lines.en: My heart is beating faster than my tail.

lines.zh: 前面是浅滩，我还能再挤一挤。
lines.en: Shoals ahead; I can squeeze a little further.

lines.zh: 它张嘴了，我得再快一点。
lines.en: It opened its mouth. I must be faster.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口水草，算是攻击。
lines.en: I bit a piece of weed. Count that as an attack.

lines.zh: 我的牙太小，你感觉不到。
lines.en: My teeth are tiny; you will barely feel them.

lines.zh: 我撞了你一下，这就是全部。
lines.en: I bumped you. That is all I have.

lines.zh: 别笑，小鱼也会生气。
lines.en: Do not laugh; small fish get angry too.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的袖子，然后被带走。
lines.en: I bit your sleeve and got carried along.

lines.zh: 这一口是为水草报仇。
lines.en: That bite was for the water weed.

lines.zh: 力气小，但咬得很认真。
lines.en: Little strength, but I bit with real feeling.

lines.zh: 我啃不动你，只能啃草。
lines.en: I cannot chew you; I chew weed instead.

lines.zh: 攻击结束，我累了。
lines.en: The attack is over. I am tired.

lines.zh: 别躲，我本来也伤不到你。
lines.en: Do not dodge; I could not hurt you anyway.

lines.zh: 一桶水倒下来，我就到这儿了。
lines.en: Someone poured a bucket, and here I am.

lines.zh: 这里不是我出生的地方。
lines.en: This is not where I was born.

lines.zh: 水是新的，味道也是新的。
lines.en: New water, new taste, new everything.

lines.zh: 我转了三圈，才敢游开。
lines.en: I circled three times before daring to swim off.

lines.zh: 有人把我放在这里，为什么。
lines.en: Someone put me here. I do not know why.

lines.zh: 池子小，但水是干净的。
lines.en: The pool is small, but the water is clean.

lines.zh: 我的橙色在新水里很扎眼。
lines.en: My orange is very obvious in this new water.

lines.zh: 没有同类，只有我。
lines.en: No others of my kind. Only me.

lines.zh: 第一件事，是找水草。
lines.en: First thing: find the water weed.

lines.zh: 我落水的时候，溅了一点水花。
lines.en: I made a small splash when I landed.

lines.zh: 水面上有火，我沉到底。
lines.en: Fire on the surface; I sink to the bottom.

lines.zh: 被捞起来又摔回去，头晕。
lines.en: Scooped up and dropped back. My head spins.

lines.zh: 我在水里，却喘不上气。
lines.en: I am in water and still cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 一声巨响，水都被震开了。
lines.en: A great bang, and the water itself was torn open.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦着我的背过去。
lines.en: An arrow skimmed past my back.

lines.zh: 这水突然变得很陌生。
lines.en: The water has suddenly become unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 两天没吃到水草了。
lines.en: Two days without a bite of weed.

lines.zh: 亮光一闪，我整条鱼都麻了。
lines.en: A flash, and my whole body went numb.

lines.zh: 离了水，我翻着往下掉。
lines.en: Out of water, I tumble down.
